steps.why: A program links libepoxy and asks it whether an extension is in a list, which needs no context.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <epoxy/gl.h>' 'int main(void) {' '  return epoxy_extension_in_string("GL_ARB_one GL_ARB_two", "GL_ARB_two") &&' '      !epoxy_extension_in_string("GL_ARB_one GL_ARB_two", "GL_ARB_t") ? 0 : 1;' '}' > /tmp/amy-libepoxy.c && cc $(pkg-config --cflags epoxy) /tmp/amy-libepoxy.c $(pkg-config --libs epoxy) -o /tmp/amy-libepoxy && /tmp/amy-libepoxy
